svg.aria-label: Code-calibrated tensor wiring differences and measured emergent layer topologies across Inkling 2 Mini, LoopRes, ALF, and LoRM
svg.text: Inside the Source Code & Probes: Wiring Divergences and Opposite Emergent Topologies
Top: Sublayer input operators calibrated line-by-line against official PyTorch repos. Bottom: Measured attribution maps reveal diametrically opposed learned circuits.
• Global: 3 Q/K/V depth reads; core: 4 gates (splits QKV)
• Resets to prelude (v₁,[v₀]) per pass; 48 KV+Conv states
No gate · AttnRes in core only
• Fused Triton cuts train overhead +54.9% → +4.8% (+0.7% mem)
• Retrofitted Qwen3-4B (45.8) beats 8B SFT (42.9); sep. KV/pass
• No 3-stage split! All 6 blocks via shared W·RMS
• hₜ,ₗ = (1−ρₗ)xₜ,ₗ + ρₗ c Σᵢ≥ₗ βᵢ→ₗ Mᵢ vₜ₋₁,ᵢ (r=64)
• On AttnRes: top-only drops to 49%; sublayer = 96%!
• Decode cost is O(L²) HBM reads (not +1.1% FLOPs)
Shared lesson: all drop top-only vectors for mid-deep columns.
Yet who reads whom diverges completely — see probes below!
Key finding: L7 pulls 69% from prev B3 (L18: 40%) = top-to-bottom.
d₂₀₂₇ is a B3-vs-B2 block beacon (17–19% of u_Q/u_V logit gap);
tied L18 writing −46 on Loop 3 proves implicit phase awareness!
Source: Goodfire Fig. 7 & Fig. 8 (13,233 tokens, 400 FineWeb docs)
Content-key variance: 'Less is more' frees token depth
• Naive AttnRes collapses full-loop path to 0.05% by pass 7
• Offloading bias to k_loop unlocks adaptive token depth:
uniform mean of 4 keeps 89–94% of gain!
Shared: top ¼ layers decode vocab; feeding hurts.
